AAI shall have full liberty to get the damage rectified at the bidder’s risk and cost. 24. nder the scope in setting right the item/equipment. The Above penalty shall be deducted from PBG / running bill. 27. AAI may change the quantity or part thereof to be supplied by +/-30% of the tender ed quantity (measurable) but within the overall deviation limit of 30% of the contract v alue. 28. AAI may purchase Extra item, Substitute items as per site requirements up to the o verall limit of 30% of the contract value. 29. AAI reserves the right to place repeat order, with the same terms & conditions as f or the first order, and the quantity of repeat order shall not exceed 50 % of quantity su pplied in the original order. 30. In case, any extra quantity/deviation in Schedule of Quantity (SOQ) needs to be executed due to site conditions, the bidder /awardee firm has to execute the item at lowest rate quoted as per S OQ. The bidder/awardee shall be required to accept the rate of item and submit his consent befor e execution of variation quantity in writing. 31. In case the successful tenderer/bidder does not accept the award letter, the party will also be d ebarred for future participation in the tenders for a period of three years. EMD of the unsuccessful agencies will be returned to them at the earliest. 32. Submit the Technical specifications compliance & acceptance as per Annexure-A. 33. Submit the Undertaking for Unconditional Acceptance of Terms & conditions of the G em Bid as per Annexure-I 34. Submit Copy of Authorization letter on company letter Head for singing (Authorized Signatory) all documents of above Gem Bid. 35. As per GeM, There shall be no Bid Security / EMD for Bids / RA having estimated value les s than ₹5 Lakhs. 36.
